description_en: Queries historical reports of intelligent O&M diagnostics
description_zh: 调用DescribeDiagnoseReport，查看智能运维的历史报告
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch describe-diagnose-report --instance-id es-cn-mp91kzb8m00090000 --lang en --report-id scheduled_2020-09-15T00:40:00 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnoseReport

parameters.help_en:
The language in which the intelligent diagnostic report is generated. Default value: browser language. Valid values:

- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French
parameters.help_zh:
生成智能诊断报告的语言。默认为浏览器语言，支持：

- en：英语
- zh：简体中文
- zt：繁体中文
- es：西班牙语
- fr：法语
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The report ID. You can obtain the report ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183774.html operation
parameters.name: report_id
